x: Usage

At 25% speed it strikes once every seven in-game days; at 100% speed, once per in-game day. The strike rate changes smoothly between these speeds. Below 25% speed, strike progress pauses. Real-time mode also counts server downtime and is not accelerated by sleeping or calendar changes. Missed strikes are combined into one strike when the hammer is loaded and powered again. Switching clock mode preserves accumulated progress.

d: Allows lighting a warning beacon fire. Place on stone or brick ground.
x: Usage

Place the lucerne on stone or brick ground. Hold <kbd title="sneak">Shift</kbd> + <kbd title="rightmouse">Right mouse</kbd> to show the structure preview; <kbd title="ctrl">Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd title="shift">Shift</kbd> + <kbd title="rightmouse">Right mouse</kbd> to hide it. Build: 1 stone/brick block under the lucerne, then a 5×5 platform in front of that block (same level). Use stone or brick; chiseled blocks: at least 50% voxels. The center 3×3×3 above the platform cannot have blocks placed. When complete, <kbd title="rightmouse">Right mouse</kbd>: add 2 fat and 32 firewood, then Light. The light burns for 24 in-game hours at the center.
Welding Process: Layer

First step is to perform the part welding process for three of the four layers. (The top layer doesn't need to be welded)

Second step is to heat up each of the layers that you have assembled and then assemble them into the final shape. This takes 3 pieces of powdered borax.

The third step is to hit it with a hammer again.
Welding Process: Layer

First step is to perform the part welding process for three of the four layers. (The top layer doesn't need to be welded)

Second step is to heat up each of the layers that you have assembled and then assemble them into the final shape. This takes 3 pieces of powdered borax.

The third step is to hit it with a hammer again.
Welding Process: Part

First step is to clayform the mold for your bell part and filling the molds with brass. For each of the three lower layers you will need 4 parts.

Second step is to heat the parts of the layer you're constructing. Place the parts into a forge with charcoal (Shift + Right mouse) to heat them. After heating the parts must be assembled together and will need 4 pieces of powdered borax for the welding.

Step three is to hit that thing with a hammer quite a few times.

The rarity of the components used makes this tool valuable for long-distance communications and emergency situations. Hold <kbd title="rightmouse">Right mouse</kbd> to activate voice amplification, carrying your voice over 125 blocks. The sound of your voice is still affected by distance and obstacles.
Welding Process: Layer

First step is to perform the part welding process for three of the four layers. (The top layer doesn't need to be welded)

Second step is to heat up each of the layers that you have assembled and then assemble them into the final shape. This takes 3 pieces of powdered borax.

The third step is to hit it with a hammer again.
Welding Process: Layer

First step is to perform the part welding process for three of the four layers. (The top layer doesn't need to be welded)

Second step is to heat up each of the layers that you have assembled and then assemble them into the final shape. This takes 3 pieces of powdered borax.

The third step is to hit it with a hammer again.
Welding Process: Part

First step is to clayform the mold for your bell part and filling the molds with brass. For each of the three lower layers you will need 4 parts.

Second step is to heat the parts of the layer you're constructing. Place the parts into a forge with charcoal (Shift + Right mouse) to heat them. After heating the parts must be assembled together and will need 4 pieces of powdered borax for the welding.

Step three is to hit that thing with a hammer quite a few times.
